capabilities: Mark files with customizable unread/later statuses via right-click
Show per-status unread counts as folder badges
Snooze dots for 1 day, 3 days, or 1 week
Step through unread files with Open Next/Previous Unread commands
Embed a filterable unread overview codeblock in any note
extras: Manual install from release files; a welcome modal appears on first install. The README warns that data.json can grow large under versioning sync services and recommends the 'Only track Markdown' option, with caveats that it does not delete existing records or remote history.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in indication of which files are new or unread across a vault, especially when folders are collapsed.
summary: Reading tracker that marks new files with colored dots, propagates unread counts into folder badges, and steps through unread files.
